description: Realistic multi-package stacks for the M0 controlled arm. Each case pins several packages at versions resolved from the registry at generation time, so the model writes against a production-shaped stack rather than one library. Purpose: the per-symbol miss rate is a property of the model and does not change with stack size — what changes is EXPOSURE, so this suite measures the project-level break rate that compounds across packages.

cases.task: Build an HTTP API module with a POST /users route that validates the body, signs a JWT for the created user, and logs the request. Export the configured app.
Build a CLI module with a "sync" subcommand taking a --since flag, coloured status output, a spinner while work runs, and a semver check on the supplied version.
Build a module that fetches a CSV over HTTP, parses it, normalizes a date column, groups rows by a key, and assigns each row a unique id.
Build a data-access module that defines a users table, runs a select with a where clause, validates the result shape, and formats createdAt for display.
Build a React component module with a form that validates input, conditionally composes class names, and formats a timestamp for display.
Build a module exporting a test helper that creates a temp fixture, a small assertion utility, and a semver-aware version guard.
